scope: Recognized source files in the supplied repository inventory, including tests and tools. Physical lines include comments and blank lines; this is code volume, not importance.
exclusions: Vendor, third-party, bundled skills, build and generated directories; named bundles and minified JS/CSS
Manifests, documentation, data, media and other non-source formats
Secret files, symlinks, unreadable/binary files and source files over 8 MB (minified means a JS/CSS line over 20k bytes)
